Within EACH 5-row creature block, views top to bottom are SOUTH (front facing viewer), SOUTHEAST (front-right quarter view), EAST (right profile), NORTHEAST (back-right quarter view), NORTH (back facing viewer). West is mirrored by the game: every side pose here must face RIGHT. Absolutely no accidental left-facing poses.

Corpse retains standing drawing scale, is low on the SAME ground line, never fills cell height.
All bodies fit inside their cells. Weapons and bow stay below skull top, contained within the cell. No glowing outlines, circular effects, shadows, scenery, particles, debris or disconnected props.
